:::{#def-cohen-kappa}
#### Cohen's kappa

**Cohen's kappa** is the agreement beyond chance,
as a fraction of the largest possible agreement beyond chance,
built from the overall agreement (@def-overall-agreement)
and the chance agreement (@def-chance-agreement):

$$\kappa \eqdef \frac{p_o - p_e}{1 - p_e}$$

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
